hotels.title: Peaceful Phuket Paradise Steps from Surin Beach with Two Pools
hotels.description: Dreamy tropical days are best spent at Outrigger Surin Beach Resort, a beach-facing haven nestled on the pristine shores of Phuket's Surin Beach. This idyllic retreat is a stone's throw away from Phuket's vibrant nightlife, high-end shopping and world-class dining venues. Spend your days exploring the Andaman Sea's crystal-clear waters, savouring delicious cuisine at Nalu Bar & Grill or simply unwinding at the resort’s shimmering pools.

hotels.title: Phuket Beachfront Escape with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Set on the shores of Bang Tao Beach, five-star Angsana Laguna Phuket puts you in the heart of Laguna, surrounded by a glittering lagoon and newly renovated resort spaces. Stretch out beside the 300-metre swimming pool, paddleboard across the water or settle into a cabana at XANA Beach Club. With five food and beverage outlets, including the beach club, there’s plenty of choice when it’s time to eat and unwind. Younger travellers can spend the day at Angsana Kids’ Club with treasure hunts, face painting and cooking classes, while you book a traditional Thai massage at Angsana Spa. Complimentary shuttle buses and boats connect you to the wider Laguna Phuket complex, with buses available on call and boats running every 20 minutes. Beyond the resort, tee off at Laguna’s 18-hole golf course, explore more spas and dining options, browse Canal Village, or follow the nature trails. Porto de Phuket and Boat Avenue are a few kilometres away, and Boat Avenue’s weekly night market adds another reason to head out.
